item.title: Myoji Temple: A Historic Buddhist Complex Away From the Crowds — Guide
item.description: Myoji Temple is a quiet, well-preserved Buddhist temple complex in Fukui, offering traditional temple architecture and a peaceful, contemplative atmosphere considerably less visited than the region’s better-known sights like Eiheiji. The temple’s grounds provide a genuine, uncrowded look at Fukui’s Buddhist heritage, making it a rewarding stop for visitors seeking a quieter alternative or complement to the prefecture’s more famous temple destinations. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Fukui, Fukui Prefecture Hours ~9:00–16:30 Admission Small entry fee, typically ¥300–500 Time needed 45–75 min Best time Year-round; spring and autumn for pleasant weather What to See Traditional Buddhist temple architecture and grounds.
